thread:
Aisha Patel: Quick sync — were doing a final sprint on the launch bundle. Need decisions on keyword anchors, JSON-LD snippets for the benchmark + webinar, and a safe redirect fallback for older campaign URLs. Can we resolve here?
Tom Rivera: Ok. Which pages are high priority for SEO attention?
Aisha Patel: Priorities: benchmark narrative (hero), webinar landing, two evergreen how-tos. Everything else is secondary.
Lara Chen: Schema plan: Article + FAQ for how-tos, Event for webinar, and incorporate an AggregateRating-like object for the benchmark (no stars, just "reviewedBy" and "reviewCount"). I'll post light JSON-LD drafts.
Ben Ortiz: Redirects: current legacy patterns include /lp/redwood-ai-2023 and /campaigns/seed. My proposal: explicit 301 map for known old->new. For unknowns, temporary 307 to /resources with a helpful message. Hold unknown redirects for 90 days and then consider a broader rule.
Tom Rivera: Prefer permanent 301 when we have a match. For unmatched, I worry about 307s hurting crawler signals — maybe route to a generator page that suggests relevant resources instead.
Aisha Patel: @Ben drop the CSV here so I can review. Also need anchor tone: short phrase vs descriptive sentence links?
Ben Ortiz: CSV snippet: ```
old_path,new_path,type
/lp/redwood-ai-2023,/launch/benchmark-narrative,301
/campaigns/seed,/resources/seed-guide,301
/blog/draft-migration,/blog/2026/inference-intro,301
```
Lara Chen: Anchor guidance: product pages get tight intent anchors (e.g., "benchmarking LLM inference"), editorial lists and blog hubs use longer descriptive anchors (e.g., "cost and latency benchmarks for inference at scale"). Mix them to avoid over-optimization.
Tom Rivera: Also: add rel=canonical on all migrated pages, and ensure old URLs return a 301 with a canonical header pointing to the destination to avoid split index signals.
Aisha Patel: Tracking wrinkle: strip UTMs on 301s but preserve the source in a short param (?orig_campaign=) that we ingest server-side, then redirect clean URL. Keeps analytics intact without UTM proliferation.
Ben Ortiz: Agreed. Implementation note: server should set a short-lived cookie with orig_campaign when redirecting, for accurate session stitching.
Lara Chen: Webinar Event JSON-LD quick draft: ```{"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"Event","name":"Redwood inference benchmarks webinar","startDate":"2026-05-12T16:00:00-07:00","location":{"@type":"VirtualLocation","url":"https://redwood.example/webinar/benchmarks"}}```
Tom Rivera: For the benchmark page: include a structured section pointing to test artifacts (s3 links) using Dataset or DataCatalog types so search can understand the methodology. No fake metrics.
Aisha Patel: Internal linking priority list: 1) Product overview -> benchmark narrative, 2) Docs/how-to -> webinar landing, 3) Benchmark post -> Dedicated trial CTA. Tom, can you draft a sample anchor list?
Tom Rivera: Will do. Sample anchors Ill add: ["benchmarking LLM inference","inference latency benchmarks","cost and throughput comparisons"].
seo-bot: Reminder: After redirects are live, update the sitemap and submit to Search Console. Verify staging canonical pages return 200 before submit. :white_check_mark:
Ben Ortiz: Edge cases: for translated content, keep language pathing (/en/, /fr/) and implement hreflang. For small translations, use x-default back to English.
Lara Chen: FAQ content: 3 to 5 concise Q&A items per how-to post to avoid duplication. Use Qs that match search intent (e.g., "How do I benchmark inference cost?").
Aisha Patel: Action items: Lara - final JSON-LD for benchmark, webinar, and FAQ by EOD. Ben - push redirects.csv to staging and QA 301s by 4pm. Tom - update internal linking doc and add anchor examples. I'll review and merge. Ping when PRs are up. :thumbsup:
